urls.rationale: 25 ILCS 170, the Lobbyist Registration Act — Illinois's primary lobbying-disclosure statute (registration, expenditure reports, contact-log disclosure).

notes: Chapter 25 (LEGISLATURE) exposes act-level TOCs; 25 ILCS 170 is the only lobbying-specific act in this chapter. Pass-3 will follow to enumerate sections if the act page is itself a TOC.
